Name: Yogs Angor
Author: phluid61
Description:
Lets Harvey grow out his beard, like a certain Angory member of the Yogscast.

This is a basic Content Patcher retexture of Harvey's character sprites and portraits. It is integrated with the Generic Mod Config Menu.

As of version 1.1.0 there are options to:

[list]
[*]disable / enable the mod (default: enabled)
[*]allow Harvey to randomly wear a beanie hat (default: enabled)
[*]make Harvey wear the hat every day in Winter regardless of the above setting (default: enabled)
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Version 1.3.1 fixes Harvey's portraits on the beach
